prompt:
A 20-second instrumental film-score cue: the first music of a quiet, dark, minimalist animated film. A young man sits alone outside at night, in shock, unable to answer a simple question. Haunting, desolate and intimate; very quiet, pianissimo, never above mezzo-piano. In tune at A = 440. Beatless free time with no pulse. Key centre A minor. Instruments, and only these: one muted cello played sul tasto without vibrato, and a felt-muted upright piano, recorded close and dry. The top octaves stay empty.
[0:00 - 0:04] Out of near silence, the cello's soft open A string (A3, the A below middle C) blooms slowly, then holds perfectly still.
[0:04 - 0:12] Over the held A, the felt piano plays six slow single notes, about 1.3 seconds apart: E5, D5, C5, B4, A4, and then a sixth note that does not belong, a high G5 a seventh above the A. Each note is left to ring; the last one hangs unresolved. The piano does not play again.
[0:12 - 0:20] Only the cello's held A remains, very soft and still, thinning to nothing by 0:19. No accents and no new material.
Instrumental only, no vocals, no choir, no humming. Avoid: drums or any percussion, impacts, booms, risers, swells, reversed sounds, rising or piercing high tones, trailer-style builds, lush strings, any melody beyond the six piano notes, sentimentality, and any major-key resolution.
